notes.title: Save the Pirate: Sea Story Updated!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We are pleased to announce that an update has been released for Save the Pirate: Sea Story!

In the update, we fixed minor bugs, improved game performance, and also added new localizations.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Yo Ho Ho! We've added a NEW ISLAND!
notes.content:
Hello pirates!

We've released a DLC with a new island! Brrr.. looks like it will be cool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38916701/194f4d79de419ee41e0a40bf349f5b3f8564730e.png[/img]

So, the pirate and his companion will go to... the Ice Island! Your main goal is to quickly explore the island and find how to warm up the character's companion. To complete the story successfully, you must definitely use your logic and make the right choice from the two available 😉

Good luck to all!

[b]PS: Try not to freeze, please... There is still a lot of interesting things ahead)[/b]
